title: Sam Kieth
description: "He had a big nose," offers Sam Kieth as an explanation for why he chose Jabba's cackling henchcreature, Salacious Crumb, to illustrate. "For some reason, I've always drawn people whose noses are too big." After wowing the comics world with DC's SANDMAN in '88, Kieth went on to illustrate EPICURUS THE SAGE and eventuallv wound up drawing WOLVERINE covers and stories for Marvel Comics. His own creation, THE MAXX, was recently published by Image Comics.
